title: Are One Page Resumes Bad?
description:

Stop watering down your experience to fit a page—keywords matter more than length!

transcript: I'm going to get a lot of hate for saying this but if you have a onepage resume as a recruiter I would just think that you're inexperienced or you don't know what you're doing because as an experienced person why do you only have a onepage resume watering down your experience to have two to three bullet points for each job just so it can fit on one page of a resume is crazy not only that but the way that the ATS rank candidates is based on keywords Whoever has those keywords is going to pull up in my search Whoever has those keywords the most is going to pull up even higher in my search not only is it unnecessary but you're actually having the opposite effect of what you want in your job search so let's just say death to the one page resme
